title: Functional Fitness
tagline: Build a body that works — strength, endurance, and mobility for real life.
curricula: NASM & ACE training fundamentals, physical-literacy curricula
disclaimer: General conditioning education, not a prescription. Stop on pain, and clear new programs with a clinician if you have a health condition or are new to exercise.
endpoint: from sedentary to a sustainable strength-and-mobility routine
about: Physical fitness is the general capacity your body brings to everything else — strength to lift, endurance to keep going, and mobility to move freely without pain. This category covers the fundamentals of training all three safely: how muscles adapt, how to structure a week, and how to progress without injury, built for real life rather than the mirror.
